name: Omegamon Alter-B
look: the knight gone dark: black armour seamed with glowing red, gold trim and talons, a horned crest with a red visor, a vast tattered black cape, a red-black blade and a black lion-head shield with a golden cannon
entry: Omegamon Alter-S consumed by its own power: its armour has turned black, and red light leaks from every seam. Its Grey Sword and Garuru Cannon are said to be able to erase a whole world.
how: Evolve Omegamon Alter-S at level 70. It can't be found in the wild.
